source.notes: Scanned school test paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. Printed header: Class 8, FIRST TEST JULY 2024, Marks : 40, PHYSICS; examYear 2024 as printed. No time allowed and no school name printed; no section headings. Question 1 items 1–7 are MCQ / assertion-reason marked '7 x 1 =7' (1 mark each), followed by item 'viii)' with one [3] for three reasons. Question 3 iii prints a single [4] after part b, so a) and b) are kept together. Where a printed mark covers a group of items it is kept as one entry with that total. Several [2] brackets in Question 2 are blurred on the scan. Student pen ticks on the scan were ignored. No answer key.
